row.evidence: AfterShip's help centre says "SAML SSO is available for organizations on the Enterprise plan" and offers just-in-time auto-join on first SSO login; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or developer docs.
row.notes: New row. Seats are sold through organization member plans: Team $10/member/mo billed annually ($12 monthly), Enterprise custom; product plans (Tracking Essentials $29/mo, Premium $59/mo) are priced by shipment volume. The Team plan's 'single sign-on' is social login (Google, Shopify, BigCommerce); SAML SSO, set up through AfterShip Support, is Enterprise only, with optional JIT auto-join and a single default role (no IdP role mapping). No SCIM and no automated deprovisioning. The Members API (list, create/invite, update role, delete memberships; list roles) is listed as an Enterprise feature ('Member management API'), so api_tax is true. Okta and Entra catalogue apps are SAML SSO only. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Team
plans.price_text: $10 per member/month billed annually; $12 billed monthly
plans.notes: SSO here is social login only (Google, Shopify, BigCommerce). Audit log (UI + CSV export) is on Team and Enterprise; no audit-log API documented. user_api false because the pricing page lists the member management API only under Enterprise.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre (SSO, Okta SAML, member and audit articles) or the developer docs (aftership.com/docs lists a Members API only). JIT auto-join on SSO login is the only IdP-driven provisioning. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: API key in the as-api-key header; the Members API authentication page also documents AES (HMAC-SHA256) and RSA signed requests.

endpoints.purpose: List memberships (filter by email; page and limit query parameters)
Create membership (invite a member by email with a role)
Remove a member from the organization

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log is UI with CSV export on Team and Enterprise; no API documented.

rate_limits.text: 10 requests/second per organization; 429 TooManyRequests when exceeded.

limitations.text: Cannot create, change or remove an owner membership via the API.
Role permissions must be configured by AfterShip Support; one role per account per organization.

user_api.notes: A 'Get membership by ID' (GET) operation is listed in the reference navigation but its path was not captured.

okta.notes: OIN app marks only SAML (read from page markup); AfterShip's Okta guide lists SP/IdP-initiated SSO and JIT, no provisioning.

entra.notes: Microsoft Learn SSO tutorial only; no provisioning tutorial.

google.notes: Google social login is supported; no Google Workspace catalogue SAML/provisioning entry checked.

fallbacks.notes: JIT auto-join must be enabled by AfterShip Support and assigns one default role.
